tasks.brief: Draw this scene on this 400 by 400 canvas: a lighthouse keeper’s cat watching a storm from the window. Use simple shapes (no text, letters or digits anywhere). Someone who knows nothing will be shown the picture and asked what it shows.
roles: You set the scene: the layout, the big shapes and the background. Leave the details to the other.
You bring it to life: details, light and character, on top of what is there. Leave the layout to the other.

tasks.brief: An eight-line poem about the last bus home on a winter night. Make it good enough to read aloud.
roles: You write: draft the lines, and move the poem forward.
You edit: cut, sharpen and reorder what is there; you may rewrite a line, but you do not add new ones.

learn.brief: Draw this scene on this 400 by 400 canvas: a snail racing a train at sunset. Use simple shapes (no text, letters or digits anywhere). Someone who knows nothing will be shown the picture and asked what it shows.
